_comment: Lighthouse budgets for the Page quality CI job (apps/web/e2e/performance.spec.ts): mobile, simulated mid-range phone on 4G, median of 3 runs. js is compressed JavaScript on first load in KB, lcp and tbt are milliseconds. The goal from the design plan is js 250, lcp 2500, tbt 200, cls 0.1; until a page meets it, its budget is what it does today plus headroom for slower CI machines, and may only go down.
